desc.en: This is not the real name of the plant. It's called by this name because it contains poison so powerful, it will kill you the moment you eat it.
desc.ja: 正式名称はオニギデロダケ。一度口に運べばその場で死に至るほど強力な毒があり、この名前で呼ばれている

desc.en: Effect: Has a chance to cause Poison when dealing damage.
desc.ja: 効果：ダメージを与えた時、にする
